Class NetworkRequest

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.requests.NetworkRequest
Direct Known Subclasses:
DisconnectNetworkRequest, DrawNetworkRequest, JoinGameNetworkRequest, NewGameNetworkRequest, NewServerConnectionRequest, PingNetworkRequest, ShowLobbyNetworkRequest, SkipDrawNetworkRequest, TotemNetworkRequest
public abstract class NetworkRequest extends Object
Data Transfer Object sent from the Client to the Server. This abstract class is used for both game-related requests and network-related requests (like the server registration request)
